short_description: Castelli & Kurucz (2003) ATLAS9 ODFNEW/NOVER fluxes, [alpha/Fe] = 0 and +0.4 (SVO Kurucz2003all)
description: ATLAS9 model-atmosphere fluxes of Castelli & Kurucz (2003), computed with the new opacity distribution functions (ODFNEW) and no convective overshooting (NOVER), mixing length l/Hp = 1.25 and microturbulence 2 km/s. SVO describes the grid as "ATLAS9 Kurucz ODFNEW /NOVER models. Newly computed ODFs with better opacities and better abundances have been used." It has two variants, each with its own MESA cube: [alpha/Fe] = 0 (3,808 spectra, [M/H] -2.5 to +0.5) and [alpha/Fe] = +0.4 (4,284 spectra, [M/H] -4.0 to +0.5). Teff 3,500-50,000 K, log g 0-5. No models exist at high Teff and low log g, so each cube has empty nodes (holes), listed in properties.json.

default_variant_note: flux_cube.bin at the top level is a byte copy of this variant's cube, for clients that read only the top-level cube: SED_Tools 0.4.1's SED.local, tested on 30 Oct 2026 (whether MESA colors reads it was not tested). [alpha/Fe] = 0 is the variant the top-level cube held before 29 Oct 2026 (equal to it to 6.5e-14). Newer clients that compare the cube with the whole lookup rebuild one cube per variant locally.
